## Scope and evidence

- What changed, and why?
- What was explicitly left out?
- Which test commands ran? Link the **head-commit** CI run.
- Are any capabilities only mocked, simulated or not yet validated on actual GPU/provider?
- For paid inference, what is the estimated per-call and per-batch cost? **Never spend without separate authorization.**

## Review checklist

- [ ] One reviewable scope, linked issue, A2A ownership and handoff
- [ ] Test(s) added/updated; local checks and CI green
- [ ] Security, privacy, licensing and model/provider terms considered
- [ ] No unauthorized API spend, secret exposure, platform fees or production uploads
- [ ] \`CHANGELOG.md\` Unreleased updated for notable changes (or N/A: tests/internal only)
- [ ] Board state updated in \`project/board.json\` + generated \`docs/SPRINT.md\` if workflow changed
- [ ] Documentation and compatibility/migration notes updated as needed
- [ ] No release tags or publishing triggered
